name: Direclidine
summary: Direclidine is an investigational antipsychotic drug for schizophrenia that was out-licensed from Nxera Pharma to Neurocrine Biosciences, a United States-based pharmaceutical company. It is an oral small molecule.

uses.text: Direclidine (INN; developmental code names NBI-1117568, HTL-0016878) is an investigational antipsychotic drug for schizophrenia that was out-licensed from Nxera Pharma to Neurocrine Biosciences, a United States-based pharmaceutical company.

pharmacology.en: It is a selective agonist of the M4 muscarinic acetylcholine receptor. Activating M4 in the brain is thought to dampen excess dopamine release, without directly blocking dopamine receptors.
pharmacology.zh: 它是M4型蕈毒鹼乙醯膽鹼受體的選擇性致效劑。一般認為，活化腦中的M4受體能抑制過多的多巴胺釋放，而不必直接阻斷多巴胺受體。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它是M4型蕈毒碱乙酰胆碱受体的选择性致效剂。一般认为，活化脑中的M4受体能抑制过多的多巴胺释放，而不必直接阻断多巴胺受体。

fact.en: It is part of a new wave of schizophrenia drugs that work through muscarinic receptors instead of blocking dopamine receptors, the same idea behind xanomeline, a component of a schizophrenia medicine approved in the United States in 2024.
fact.zh: 它屬於新一代思覺失調症藥物，透過蕈毒鹼受體發揮作用，而不是阻斷多巴胺受體。2024年在美國核准的一種思覺失調症藥物中的成分xanomeline，也是基於同樣的概念。
fact.zhHans: 它属于新一代思觉失调症药物，通过蕈毒碱受体发挥作用，而不是阻断多巴胺受体。2024年在美国核准的一种思觉失调症药物中的成分xanomeline，也是基于同样的概念。
